summary: E-Power Inc., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its extraordinary general meeting held September 4, 2026. Shareholders approved an ordinary resolution for a share consolidation and a special resolution to adopt amended articles of association reflecting the consolidation. Votes for resolution 1 were 152,393,556 for, 727,544 against, and 4,214 abstaining; resolution 2 similarly passed. The filing is a routine corporate action notification with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender, or restructuring. No deal terms, advisor, or premium were disclosed; the filing merely confirms shareholder approval of a share consolidation.
